scope: texture-name memory-safety correction; no rendering or milestone acceptance
problem: For 4..7 byte names without a three-character extension, the original res[-8] reads before the destination.
The original advances res by input length after a bounded copy; truncated input can produce an out-of-bounds store.
change: Use the copied/in-place string length to locate its terminator and require at least eight bytes before inspecting res[-8]. Preserve case-sensitive type selection and existing suffix-stripping rules on defined inputs.

output: Original: four buffer under-reads and one out-of-bounds store reproduced; 66 defined cases identical.
Patched actual texFixName/strncpyt: 161 ASan/UBSan cases pass; copied/in-place, short names, extensions, truncation, source nonmutation.
controls.original_source_reproduction: Use Game/src/render/tex.c from patchwork commit 45ce405 (or source prepared through patch0101).
limits: Original strncpyt body uses a host strncpy_s adapter for valid positive-capacity copies; Windows CRT is not qualified.
Only local LeakSanitizer disabled due to restricted /proc. CI sanitizer defaults are unchanged.
Null, unterminated, partially overlapping and nonpositive-capacity nonalias inputs are not claimed valid.
